title: Weather-tolerant double climb, low altitude
terrain: forested / non-exposed, 2 x ~400m D+, total D- ~800m non-technical
coachNotes: ARPA gives widespread and locally intense rain from Thursday to at least Sunday 23, so this is written to be done in rain, not in a window. Tree line and below, no crests, no exposed traverses, no via ferrata cable sections, and abort to the valley on the first thunder. Wet limestone is the reason this is not the Presolana. FALLBACK if it is electrical rather than just wet: 2h30 indoor trainer, 3x20m at 84-89% LTHR with 10m easy between, then 20m flat jog off the bike, load 130. Take the fallback without negotiating, the weekend is aerobic maintenance now, the descent stimulus was Wednesday. Eat every 40 minutes either way, the fuelling rehearsal still has to happen. Garmin expect 230-280.
